liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (3 reviews): Garcia sounded unusually self-confident and out front in the Shakedown into Looks Like Rain stretch; Opened the second set; Jerry missed a verse but stayed calm instead of getting flustered [9][10][12]
- **Terrapin Station** (1 review): Nice overall, but a major problem occurred during the whistle-screaming lyric section [12]
- **The Days Between** (1 review): Haunting, closing with a lovely though brief jam [6]
- Reviewer found it excellent and memorable for years afterward [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **encore Bob talk**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1995-05-29.pzm.russjcan.92059.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 166 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [1]
- **gd1995-05-29.140930.fob.schoeps.cmc3.mk41.miller.clugston.flac1648**: audience recording; 19 songs; 165 min; rated 2.33/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1995-05-29.fob.schoeps.unknown.larson.34270.flac16**: audience recording; 18 songs; 164 min; rated 3/5 by 14 [3]. Said about its sound: Front-of-board audience recording sounds stunning [16]
- **gd95-05-29.schoeps.10070.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 164 min; rated 2.93/5 by 13 [4]. Said about its sound: Breezy day scattered the sound across the meadows, so audience tapes suffer somewhat; Wind badly damaged all the audience recordings of the show; Windswept sound runs throughout the show and is clearly audible on this recording [4][6][7][8]

## Around the show

- Before the encore, Bob asked whether someone had cursed the Christian right; Lon Mabon was absent [6]
- Reviewer stood on the rail directly in front of Garcia from Space through Sugar Magnolia [8]
- Reviewer skipped the first set due to severe sunburn from the day before, despite the heat [10]
- Before the encore, Bobby asked if he heard someone say a profane line about the Christian right [13]
- Bob's pre-encore remark asking if someone said a profane line about the Christian right is noted [2]
- Late in the band's career Jerry often seemed withdrawn up close, unlike here [9]
- Reviewer thought this show was much better than the previous day's [12]
- First set ranks among the best of the band's final shows [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1995-05-29.pzm.russjcan.92059.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Russjcan; transferred by Russjcan; source: Hat Mounted Realistic PZM,s with Sony WMD6-C 1st set Sony Metal-SR 100 No nr 2nd set Maxell MX 110 No nr 40 feet away,Dead Center [1]
- **gd1995-05-29.140930.fob.schoeps.cmc3.mk41.miller.clugston.flac1648**: transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Master (FOB) Audience Dat (16/48); Schoeps CMC3/MK41 > Panasonic SV255 (16/48); Transfer Info: Dat (16/48) (Sony PCM-R500) > Sound… [2]. Also: Source DAT and its transfer both came from Charlie Miller; recorded front-of-board with Schoeps microphones [2]
- **gd1995-05-29.fob.schoeps.unknown.larson.34270.flac16**: transferred by Chris Larson; source: Audience FOB: Schoeps CMC6 & MK21 > DAT(48kHz) [3]
- **gd95-05-29.schoeps.10070.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Paul B. and Chris L.; source: Audience: Schoeps MK21's [4]. Also: Disc 2 to disc 3 transition lacks a brief subsecond segment on the masters, causing a jump [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by gocollect.com: [MXP-89.3 Grateful Dead Portland Meadows 1995 Value - GoCollect](https://gocollect.com/concert-poster/mxp-89-3-grateful-dead-portland-meadows-1995) [19]
